WINDIGO-Related Publications
============================

This page provides a list of publications related to, or making use of WINDIGO. 

Wisienski, J. N. and Terlizzi, S., 2026. Initial Results from an Open-Source 
Workflow for Streamlined Nuclear Data Sensitivity and Uncertainty Analysis, in:
Proceedings of PHYSOR 2026 International Conference.
doi: `10.5281/zenodo.20803925 <https://zenodo.org/records/20803926>`_.
